# Copilot instructions for this repository

This repository is the organisation's central marketplace for agent plugins. Every plugin is consumed by Claude Code, VS Code (Copilot), Copilot CLI and Cursor from the same files.

## Ground rules

- Plugins are authored in the open Agent Plugins 1.0 format. The sources are each plugin's root `plugin.json`, `mcp.json`, `skills/` and `com.github.copilot/`. These are generated by scripts: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json`, `agents/`, `commands/` and `.cursor-plugin/` inside each plugin, plus `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json` and `catalog.json` at the root. Never suggest editing generated files by hand. Suggest running `python3 scripts/sync_manifests.py` and `python3 scripts/build_catalog.py` instead.
- Hard checks (eval count, manifests, links, secrets, version bump) run in CI. Don't repeat them in review comments. Focus on the judgment checks in `.github/instructions/plugin-review.instructions.md`.
- Follow `docs/plugin-standard.md` and `docs/skill-authoring-standard.md`.
